summary: Release blocker found live by the user during MPI-450. Wan 2.2 with only i2v weights installed still offered t2v_ms; ComfyUI rejected the graph (UNETLoader value_not_in_list on Wan_22_t2v_High/Low) and the 400 surfaced as the REPORT ON GITHUB dialog. Root is availability, not the dialog: per-op deps exist in models.js and deriveInstalledOps already computes the installed-op set, but the PromptBox op strip never consults it. Second defect: a validation rejection must be a toast naming the missing weight, extending MPI-229s _findNodeErrorLora rather than inventing a path. Added to MPI-450 Gate A.
